Yusuke Mochida}} {{nihongo|'''''Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger'''''|海賊戦隊ゴーカイジャー|Kaizoku Sentai Gōkaijā}} is the 35th season of the ''[[Super Sentai]]'' series and celebrates the 35th Anniversary of the franchise. It premiered on TV Asahi on February 13, 2011, joining ''{{KR|Kamen Rider OOO}}'' and later ''{{KR|Kamen Rider Fourze}}'' as programs featured on TV Asahi's "Super Hero Time" programming block. The season's motif is {{W|Piracy|pirates}} and follows the story of five young space pirates in search of the "[[Greatest Treasure in the Universe]]". Its footage and anniversary theme was then adapted into the second season of the 20th anniversary Power Rangers season, ''[[Power Rangers Megaforce]]'', the 2014 series ''[[Power Rangers Super Megaforce]]''. The average ratings of the series were 5.0%.http://www10.atwiki.jp/shichouseiko/pages/506.html ==Development== For the 35th Sentai series, Toei decided to go big with a major series that acknowledged the past while developing something new and interesting. Following on their success of ''{{KR|Kamen Rider Decade}}'' which crossed over elements and concepts of the 9 previous Heisei Riders as well as matters throughout franchise history, they devised a series where similar concepts and cameos would emerge, officially in-canon uniting the Super Sentai timelines (As had been happening in the Versus movies for many years) to permit a team of Sentai heroes used the powers of the previous 34 teams, using the idea that they were aliens who had no idea about the Sentai legacy and their powers were "pirated" versions of all the other teams. The original intent was to have only teams who were going to give a notable power that would help the Gokaigers appear in a cameo, most notably [[:Category:Gekirangers|the]] [[:Category:Go-Ongers|previous]] [[:Category:Shinkengers|four]] [[:Category:Goseigers|teams]] and [[:Category:Magirangers|several]] [[:Category:Dekarangers|other]] [[:Category:Hurricanegers|notable]] [[:Category:Gaorangers|teams]], as well as [[Gokaiger Goseiger Super Sentai 199 Hero Great Battle|a film]] with several others appearing in a cameo. However, the tragedy of the {{W|2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami|2011 Tohoku Earthquake}} on March 11, 2011, lead to a major outcry to create a series that helped people cope with the tragedies and inspire hope to all people. Sentai alumni appeared in many of the episodes in response, unexpectedly leading to changes of story preventing more character development but ultimately letting one actor from all 34 previous series appear throughout the entire series' run. ==Plot== {{#tag:tabber| 1= {{Quote|The 34 Super Sentai who have protected the smiles of the people! {{nihongo|'''Camera Org'''|カメラオルグ|Kamera Orugu|3}} was a camera-themed [[Baron Orgs|Baron Org]].

==History==
Born when an Org Spirit possessed a camera, he pretended to be a mundane camera put on sale in a shop. He was then bought by a boy named Takuya, unaware of his true nature. The boy began taking photos throughout the town, with the subjects of the photos began disappearing. As he took a photo of his friend, Natsumi, the Duke Org revealed himself, and blackmails the by into taking more photos using Camera Org. [[Gaku Washio|Gaku]] finds the boy and pursues him, and as the boy abandoned the camera, GaoYellow attempts to fight Camera Org alone. During the fight, Camera Org took a photo of him before escaping. Receiving an upgrade that allows him to take photos on his own, he began taking photos around town. Encountering GaoRed, he tricked Camera Org and managed to obtain his film, restoring Camera Org's victims. His lens was later shattered by GaoYellow, and was destroyed by the [[Evil-Crushing Hyakuju Sword|Hundred Beast Sword]]. Grown giant by [[TsueTsue]]'s Org Seeds, he was destroyed yet again by a point blank blast of the Animal Heart attack by GaoKing.{{storylink|Quest 03: The Eagle Vanishes!!}}

He caused mayhem and the Ninningers finished him until he revived again. In his second destruction, Takaharu brought his watch's remains and accidentally left it in the Igasaki Ninjutsu dojo, which caused the awakened Nekomata to endanger [[Fuka Igasaki|Fuka]]'s friends. Nekomata leapt 10 years into the past again while bringing Fuka's schoolmates along, forcing her and Takaharu to tail him into the past as well. With help of young Fuka, Nekomata was tricked into revealing himself as Aka Ninger and Shiro Ninger fight him and they were brought back to the present. {{nihongo|'''Movie Jamen'''|ムービー邪面|Mūbī Jamen}} is a projector-themed red body [[Jamenshi]] of the [[Dark Empire Yodonheim]], the host of the [[Director Minosaur]] and the secondary antagonist of ''[[Mashin Sentai Kiramager vs. Ryusoulger]]''.

==History==
Seeing him as a fellow artist, [[Mask of Darkness Carantula|Carantula]] created him and gave him the opportunity to bring Yodoheim to Earth with whatever means he wants. To that degree, he decided to create a dark movie that would premiere around the world via a projection in the sky. However, as Yodonna made herself producer of his film, she kept rushing and pushing him to finish the movie way ahead of his schedule. Feeling dejected that his artistic visions aren't understood by her, he soon shortly met [[Kleon]]. Kleon sympathized with the Jamen and even try to get him to turn over a new leaf when he mentioned how he used to create Minosaurs with his ooze to terrorize everyone, but not anymore. Overhearing their conversation, [[Yodonna]] suddenly attacks Kleon, forcing him to spill his ooze and show this ability. Movie Jamen accidentally swallow some and immediately after, a [[Director Minosaur]] is born. Impressed by the results, Yodonna forces Kleon to produce more ooze until a total of 4 Minosaurs are created. She let Movie Jamen use them if it means having better results.

Because of his [[Minosaurs]] directing a different scene for his movie, Yodonna wanted Movie Jamen on the editing floor in order to finish his movie with whatever footage they filmed. However, Movie Jamen felt the movie was incomplete and wanted to film important scenes, despite Yodonna caring more about the results than the artistic vision behind it. Due to interference by [[Takamichi Crystaria|Takami]] and [[Canalo]], Movie Jamen fled to film his High School Musical scene by himself. During the audition for a song and dance number, [[Juru Atsuta|Juru]] was able able to wow him and made him drop his Clapperboard Axe, the key needed to enter and leave the set. Furious at the outcome, he kidnaps [[Princess Mabushina|Mabushina]] in order to film the climax of the movie, but during the final battle against the [[Kiramagers]] and [[Ryusoulgers]], Yodonna went behind his back and finished the movie. Despite his pleads that the movie was incomplete, Yodonna projected it anyways. Seeing the results of his incomplete movie being projected filled him with so much sadness, anger, and destressed, a powerful wave of darkness spew forth from him. Not only did it end the projection, but it also absorbed the four Minosaurs into his being and transformed him into a single, giant, mindless Minosaur. Despite this form, he was quickly defeated by the combined powers of [[Mashin Gattai Kiramaizin|Kiramaizin]] and KishiRyuOh Five Knights.

After his death, his Tojiru Gear lasted another life by reforming a [[Kudaitests|Kudaitest]] into [[Great Omikuji World]].

==History==
In the shopping district, the Omikuji World placed a couple of misfortune slips on every citizens foreheads until he was spotted by [[Magine]] and [[Vroon]] who transformed and open fired at the Omikuji World from behind. They demand to set the world of Omikuji free, but instead he used his Mugen Mikuji and fired a misfortune slips at the duo as well. They tried to deal some damage towards the Omikuji World, but misfortunes always happens. Luckily, [[Kaito Goshikida|Kaito]], [[Juran]] and [[Gaon]] arrived on scene as they assist their 2 misfortuned Zenkaigers, but when they arrived, the Omikuji World somehow escaped.

Later, he appeared at a parking lot and was about to give more people some misfortune when he was shot down by the arrival of Kaito, Gaon and Juran. So the trio transformed and battle the Omikuji World as he summons an army of [[Kudaks]] to aid him in battle. During the fight, Gaon claimed that the Omikuji World is a fraud with just bad lucks, so in retaliation the Omikuji World used his Mugen Mikuji and fired more fortune at the Kudaks giving them the uphand in battle. The Zenkaigers are having troubles with the Fortune Kudaks and to make things even worst, the Omikuji World used his Mugen Mikuji and fired three misfortunes to Kaito, Gaon and Juran and with that all five of them as indicated by the Omikuji World their now known as "Bad Luckger". Kaito tries to counter this bad luck state as he tries to summon the Zenkaiju Gear but it got hit by a moving truck. He then tried to use Kyuranger Sentai Gear, but he accidentally fired at a fire hydrant causing it to spray water at the misfortune hero.

Later, Kaito used the Zenryoku Cannon in hopes of summoning some assistants but summoned [[Kirenger]], [[Battle Cossack]] and [[Yellow4]] instead as they were easily defeated by the Omikuji World. Magine had enough with this mishap as she tries desperately to take on the Omikuji World by herself only for him to punch her back despite her bad luck being good luck. With this encouragement thanks to Magine, the Zenkaigers manage to land a couple of hits onto the Omikuji World while bad lucks are going around them and after that he was then destroyed by the Pink Vibrance, thus reversing the effects.

==Personality==
Just like all the [[:Category:Worlds|Worlds]] before him, Omikuji World was arrogant and ruthless to a degree, such as disliking being called a "fraud", and sought nothing but to accomplish the [[Tojitendo]]'s goal to conquer the Zenkaigers' world using the abilities best suited for him based on his particular [[Sentai Gears#Tojiru Gears|Tojiru Gear]]. He liked to revel on the misfortunes of others and thoroughly enjoyed the sights of his enemies suffering under the bad luck caused by his fortune slips' powers, as shown when he toyed around with the Zenkaigers during their fight against him and playfully yet insultingly called the team {{Nihongo|"Bad Luckgers"|運悪ジャー}} when the fight continued to deteriorate in their disfavor.
